FORMOL ECO: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Formol Eco, April 2023, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/formol-eco.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Formol Eco where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. Formol Eco is a chemical release agent applied to concrete formwork which contains a mimimum of 90% recycled mineral oil. It is designed to act as a bondbreaker between formwork or moulds and freshly placed concrete. Formol Eco protects both steel and timber formwork since it acts as rust inhibitor and waterproofer.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Formol Eco can be used as a general purpose release agent on construction sites. It can be applied to formwork or moulds made of timber, steel or fibreglass. Formol Eco has been found to assist in protetcting the equipment used in the concrete industry, a thin coating layer of Formol Eco on agitator bowls, wheelbar-rows, shovels etc will make them easier to clean.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Formol Eco
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Recycled Mineral Oil-based Formwork Release Agent
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Equally effective on steel or timber.
    - Allows for fast and easy striking of formwork.
    - Economical and easy to apply.
    - Extremely stable during placement and vibration of concrete.
    - Does not stain or contaminate the finished concrete surface.
    - Reduces rust build up on steel moulds.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Light brown liquid
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 205 litre drum; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: This product has a shelf life of one (1) year
    - Storage conditions: Store protected from direct sunlight

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 19 m²/litre on timber 30 m²/litre on steel
4.3 Application.
    - Surfaces to be coated should be clean and free from grease, debris, loose rust and old concrete.
    - Formol® ECO is supplied ready to use and should not be diluted. The optimum method of application is by conventional spray equipment, however, a brush or roller can be used.
    - Formol® ECO should be applied at the recommended coverage rate to obtain a thin and even film over the entire surface of the mould or formwork.
    - Any excess liquid remaining on the surface after application should be mopped off.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Treated formwork should not be left exposed to weathering or dust accumulation for long periods.
    - New unsealed timber will initially require 2 to 3 coats of Formol® ECO due to the porosity of timber.
    - Only a thin film of the product is required for maximum performance. Excess application may cause staining, and should be removed before concrete placement.
4.5 Further information. Clean all tools immediately after application with Sika® Colma Cleaner.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Formol Eco, April 2023, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/formol-eco.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Formol Eco, version 07/11/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/Formol%20ECO.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Formol® Eco, version 16/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/sds-formol-eco.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
